$comment: Draft depth of the HSM Product profile: the HSM's key hierarchy. For each key store, the store whose key protects it, up to the root that the hardware protects, with the key block format each store uses. A buyer reads it to see which keys move when the wrapping algorithm of one level changes. Draft only; not part of Release 1.
title: HSM Key Hierarchy (Draft)

objective.$comment: C1. A depth of HSM Product: the same decision, with the hierarchy needed to plan a change of wrapping algorithm.
objective.consumer: An HSM owner planning a change of algorithm, or an assessor acting for one.
objective.decision: Which keys must be re-wrapped or re-issued, and in which order, when the algorithm that protects one level of the hierarchy changes.
decisionOptions: re-issue under a new parent key

interfaceRules.note: The storage interface whose key protects the keys in this store, or 'hardware-root' for the store at the top of the hierarchy, whose key the tamper-responsive hardware protects. Following protectedBy from any store reaches the root.
The format of the key blocks in this store. With keyWrapping (baseline I10), it gives the algorithm and the format at each level of the hierarchy.

exclusions.reason: Excluded at every depth. The hierarchy describes the stores and how they protect each other, not the keys in them.

changelog.summary: First draft, from the financial services draft, 9.1 (key hierarchy depth).
